slides.notes: Welcome. Today we follow a photon from the sun into a sugar molecule.

slides.title: Photosynthesis stores the sun's energy in sugar
bullets: **Inputs:** carbon dioxide from the air and water from the soil
**Energy:** sunlight, captured by chlorophyll in the chloroplasts
**Outputs:** glucose for the plant, oxygen released into the air
Almost all food chains on Earth start here
slides.notes: Write the overall equation on the board: 6CO2 + 6H2O gives C6H12O6 + 6O2.

slides.title: The light reactions make ATP and NADPH

steps.label: Light absorbed
steps.text: Chlorophyll in photosystem II absorbs a photon and excites an electron

steps.label: Water split
steps.text: The lost electron is replaced by splitting water, which releases oxygen

steps.label: Electron transport
steps.text: The electron passes along a chain that pumps protons into the thylakoid

steps.label: ATP and NADPH
steps.text: ATP synthase and photosystem I make the energy carriers the Calvin cycle uses

steps.label: Reduction
steps.text: ATP and NADPH turn 3-PGA into G3P

steps.label: Sugar out
steps.text: One G3P in six leaves to build glucose

steps.label: Regeneration
steps.text: The rest rebuild RuBP, using more ATP
